news.h: Bombay High Court quashes ICICI Bank’s nod to prosecute ex-CEO Chanda Kochhar in ‘loan fraud’ case
news.catch: The Bombay HC passed the order on a petition filed by former ICICI Bank CEO Chanda Kochhar, claiming that the bank had not followed proper procedure while granting sanction to prosecute her
news.why: Constitutional law: which Article, which court, and what the ruling changes.

news.h: Rupee rises 24 paise to 93.27 against U.S. dollar in early trade
news.catch: Forex traders said the appreciation in the rupee was primarily fuelled by a steep overnight drop in Brent crude oil prices, which eases India's import bill and inflation concerns
news.why: How a law is made, and which list or Article it draws its power from.

news.h: India, Japan set to review defence ties as Rajnath, Jaishankar arrive in Tokyo
news.catch: The two-day visit comes a day after the Quad leaders' summit in Manila, Philippines and as India hosts a joint humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) exercise involving the four member countries
news.why: Defence: the platform, the agency that built it, and what it replaces.

quiz.q: The Pralay missile, whose user trials concluded in November 2026, is a:
o: quasi-ballistic missile with a range of up to 500 km
quiz.e: Pralay is a solid-fuelled quasi-ballistic missile with a range of up to 500 km that can manoeuvre in flight to evade defences.

quiz.q: The Pralay user trial of November 2026 was conducted from:
o: Wheeler Island, now Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island
quiz.e: The launch took place from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the Odisha coast, with range instruments at Chandipur tracking it.

quiz.q: Pralay is developed by which organisation?
quiz.e: Pralay has been developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation.

quiz.q: Exercise MILAN 2026, hosted by the Indian Navy at Visakhapatnam, was accompanied by:
quiz.e: MILAN 2026 was held alongside an International Fleet Review at Visakhapatnam in February 2026, with 74 nations taking part.

quiz.q: The International Fleet Review held in February 2026 was India's:
quiz.e: India had held fleet reviews in 2001 and 2016; the 2026 review at Visakhapatnam was the third.

quiz.q: Exercise PRAGATI 2026, held at Umroi in Meghalaya, was a maiden exercise involving:
o: armies of Indian Ocean Region countries
quiz.e: PRAGATI 2026 was the first table-top and field training exercise among armies of Indian Ocean Region countries.

quiz.q: Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026, the second edition of India's multinational air exercise, was held at:
quiz.e: The second edition was held at Jodhpur with the theme 'Power in Partnership'.

quiz.q: Exercise Yudh Abhyas is conducted between India and:
quiz.e: Yudh Abhyas is the India-United States army exercise; its 22nd edition was held in 2026.

quiz.q: INS Nipun, commissioned in 2026, belongs to which class of vessels?
quiz.e: INS Nipun is the second of the Nistar-class diving support vessels, commissioned at Mumbai.

quiz.q: India took over the chairmanship of the Indian Ocean Naval Symposium for the term:
quiz.e: India assumed the IONS chairmanship for 2026-28, sixteen years after hosting the forum.
